subject: Fix false sharing issue between main thread and io-threads when access `used_memory_thread`. (#1179)
reason: The change only pads and cache-line-aligns the static used_memory_thread array in zmalloc.c to avoid false sharing between the main thread's counter and the io-threads' counters. It is a performance optimization with no behaviour change: the per-thread memory accounting values, zmalloc_used_memory's sum, and all externally observable output (INFO memory, maxmemory enforcement, command replies, replication, persistence) are computed exactly as before; only the array's memory layout differs.
